definitions.explanation: The part of the year with little rain, in tropical and subtropical regions that have distinct wet and dry seasons. Also written {乾期|かんき}.

examples.english: It is the dry season now.

examples.japanese: {乾季|かんき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{川|かわ}→川：02186_kawa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ほとんど→ほとんど：00847_hotondo⟧⟦{干上|ひあ}がる→干上がる：17376_hiagaru⟧。
examples.english: In the dry season the river almost dries up.

examples.japanese: ⟦タイ→タイ：31002_tai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧なら、⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{少|すく}ない→少ない：01136_sukunai⟧{乾季|かんき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦おすすめ→おすすめ：09746_osusume⟧だ。
examples.english: If you are travelling in Thailand, the dry season, with little rain, is the best time.

notes:
WRITING:
Both {乾季|かんき} and {乾期|かんき} are standard; {季|き} stresses the season, {期|き} the period.

RELATED WORDS:
- {雨季|うき}: rainy season (the opposite of {乾季|かんき})
- ⟦{梅雨|つゆ}→梅雨：02232_tsuyu⟧: Japan's early-summer rainy season, a different idea from a tropical {雨季|うき}

WATCH OUT:
The reading かんき also belongs to ⟦{換気|かんき}→換気：00172_kanki⟧ (ventilation) and ⟦{寒気|かんき}→寒気：12433_kanki⟧ (cold air), so the word is usually clear only in writing or in context.
